finding: Preference save had no initiating-session/workspace check or synchronous mutation lock; push operations could finish while a settings save was pending
changes: Shared synchronous lock serializes preference saving and push connect/remove
Settings save disabled during pending connection management
Session version and coordinator generation scope checked before applying save success/error
Push scope upgraded from key equality to coordinator generation, so leaving and returning cannot revive old operations
Lock released in finally on success/failure/stale response
limits: Deferred API/browser doubles used; no actual preference write, permission request, subscription creation/removal
Already-started server operations are not cancelled by ignoring obsolete UI responses
Full journey acceptance and CSS size gate remain open
